rows.quote: This dataset originated from the European ancestry segment of a recent multi-ancestry GWAS on T2DM, comprising 242,283 cases and 1,569,734 controls (23).

rows.quote: For summary-level GWAS data related to T2DM complications, the datasets were collected from the FinnGen R9 database (https://r9.finngen.fi/) (24), including T2DM with coma (ICD-10: E11.0), ketoacidosis (ICD-10: E11.1), kidney complications (ICD-10: E11.2), retinal complications (ICD-10: E11.3), neuropathy (ICD-10: E11.4), and peripheral circulatory complications (ICD-10: E11.5).
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the FinnGen R9 database (r9.finngen.fi).
